data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Immanu-El, meaning 'God is with us'. In the Old Testament, this name was given to the son of Aaron, the high priest. Emmauel is also a prophecy of the coming Messiah in the New Testament, as Jesus is referred to as Immanuel in Isaiah 7:14. The name Emmauel carries the meaning “God with us” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emmauel usually hope their child will grow to embody god with us and live with faith, good character and purpose.
